topic: The noisy vacuum cleaner 'monster' turns out to be harmless.

episode.title: Mishi & Bruno: The Rumbly Vacuum Mystery

shots.narration: What is making that enormous rumble behind the cushion?
shots.scene: Cosy colourful living room, round cushion partly hiding a plain circular robot vacuum, warm sunlight, 3D family animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: The robot vacuum slowly nudges the cushion forward.
shots.mood: Playful mystery; Mishi's green eyes are curious, and Bruno's floppy ears are rai

shots.narration: Bruno decides the rumble needs a very polite greeting.
shots.scene: Sunny living room rug beside the cushion, rounded furniture, plain robot vacuum partly visible, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Bruno gives the hidden vacuum a little bow.
shots.mood: Gentle comedy; Bruno looks earnest, while Mishi watches thoughtfully.

shots.narration: [giggles] This little rumble monster has a very round bottom!
shots.scene: Warm living room with an open patch of wooden floor beside the rug, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: The round robot vacuum rolls out from behind the cushion.
shots.mood: Bright and silly; the appliance is plain and friendly-looking, without a face.

shots.narration: Mishi spots a button on its smooth, shiny top.
shots.scene: Close view of the plain robot vacuum with one large unmarked button, sunny wooden floor, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Mishi points one fluffy paw toward the button.
shots.mood: Careful discovery; Mishi's red ear bow catches the warm light.

shots.narration: One gentle tap makes the rumbling stop.
shots.scene: Living room floor beside the stationary robot vacuum, its large unmarked button clearly visible, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Mishi presses the vacuum's stop button with one paw.
shots.mood: Calm and reassuring; Bruno stands nearby with a relaxed expression.

shots.narration: [surprised] No monster teeth, just a little cleaning brush!
shots.scene: Floor-level view of the stopped robot vacuum, small side brush visible beneath its rounded edge, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Bruno lowers his head to inspect the stationary side brush.
shots.mood: Curious and comfortable; Bruno's big black nose remains clear of the brush.

shots.narration: Mishi finds dust waiting in the vacuum's path.
shots.scene: Sunny wooden floor with a small patch of dust ahead of the stopped vacuum, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Mishi points toward the dusty patch.
shots.mood: Clear visual discovery; both friends look interested.

shots.narration: Bruno clears a cushion from its cleaning route.
shots.scene: Cosy living room with the stopped vacuum facing a dusty floor patch and a loose cushion, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Bruno pushes the cushion onto the rug.
shots.mood: Helpful and upbeat; Bruno's blue bone-shaped collar tag is visible.

shots.narration: [excited] Ready, little helper? Your dusty dinner is waiting!
shots.scene: Clear wooden floor ahead of the robot vacuum, dust patch nearby, both friends safely beside its route, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Mishi taps the vacuum's unmarked start button.
shots.mood: Cheerful anticipation; the friends look relaxed and confident.

shots.narration: The rumbling helper leaves a lovely clean trail.
shots.scene: Sunlit living room floor with a visible dusty patch and a clean strip behind the vacuum, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: The robot vacuum travels across the dust patch.
shots.mood: Satisfying payoff; Mishi and Bruno watch from the rug.

shots.narration: Bruno gives their helpful new machine a grateful bow.
shots.scene: Clean living room floor beside an open garden doorway, vacuum in the background, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Bruno bows toward the passing vacuum.
shots.mood: Affectionate comedy; Mishi sits nearby with a pleased expression.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Understanding brings courage; next, why does that wagon squeak?
shots.scene: Sunny garden patio outside the living room, small red toy wagon with plain wheels, soft flowers, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno gently nudges the wagon forward with one paw.
shots.mood: Warm friendship and fresh curiosity; both friends focus on one slightly wobbling

episode.endHook: Next adventure: why does the little garden wagon squeak?
episode.description: A noisy vacuum sounds like a little rumble monster, but Mishi and Bruno discover a helpful household machine. Together, they learn that understanding something unfamiliar can make it less surprising.
